title: On independent sets in uncrowded uniform hypergraphs
summary: We prove an average-degree lower bound on the independence number of uncrowded uniform hypergraphs. For every fixed $r\geq 2$ and every $η>0$, there exists $d_*=d_*(r,η)$ such that any uncrowded $(r+1)$-uniform hypergraph $G$ with $n$ vertices and average degree $d\geq d_*$ satisfies \[ α(G)\geq (1-η)r^{-1/r}\left(\frac{\log d}{d}\right)^{1/r}n. \] The proof combines a cleaning procedure, which reduces the maximum top-layer degree to the average scale, with a random nibble procedure that repeatedly extracts independent vertices while controlling all lower-order degrees created by the…
